settings.body: Ruth Thorne and Chidi Abara founded the firm in Portland in 2015. Six people now handle estate planning, probate and trust administration, and the law a small business needs, with a meeting room in Vancouver by appointment.

settings.text: Chidi Abara forms the company, writes its contracts and, when the day comes, acts on its sale.

settings.text: Plain answers about the first meeting, our fees and how we work.

settings.question: What does the first meeting cost?
settings.answer: $150 for 30 minutes by video, credited to your plan if you go ahead.

settings.question: Do you meet by video?
settings.answer: Yes. The first meeting is by video, and later meetings can be by video, at our Portland office or, by appointment, in Vancouver.

settings.question: How do you charge?
settings.answer: Every matter is quoted on its own after the first meeting, and the quote is set out in an engagement letter before we start.

settings.question: Do you handle probate in Washington?
settings.answer: Yes. Ruth Thorne is admitted in Washington as well as Oregon, and we meet Washington clients in Vancouver.

settings.question: Does sending the form make you my lawyers?
settings.answer: No. We are your lawyers once we have both signed an engagement letter.

settings.text: Tell us what you need in a sentence or two. We reply within one working day with who would handle it and when we can meet.
